title: Protocol for Tri-culture of hiPSC-Derived Neurons, Astrocytes, and Microglia
protocol: Thaw a vial of previously NGN2-rTTA transduced hiPSCs.
Plate the cells onto 3 wells of a 1:50 Matrigel-coated 6-well plate at a density of 7 × 10^4 cells/cm² in Stem MACS iPS-Brew XF media with 10 μM Y27632.
Re-seed the cells (now at an NPC-like stage) after 24 hours onto a 1:20 Matrigel-coated 6-well plate at a density of 1 × 10^5 cells/cm² in high FGF Astrocyte media for maintenance.
Let grow with half media exchanges every 3 days.
Re-plate via the same method as for hiPSCs at a ratio of 1:2 when cells reach ∼90% confluency.
Re-plate to 1:35 Matrigel-coated plates.
Exchange half media to low FGF Astrocyte media on day 30.
Continue feeding and growing in low FGF Astrocyte media up to day 69.
Exchange half media to ScienCell astrocyte media on day 70.
Continue performing half media exchanges in ScienCell astrocyte media, letting grow and expand to day 90.
Re-plate without coating with Matrigel at day 90.
Thaw a vial of hiPSCs and plate onto 3 wells of a 1:50 (Matrigel: DMEM:F-12) Matrigel-coated 6-well plate in Stem MACS iPS-Brew XF media with 10 μM Y27632.
Allow cells to grow until ∼80% confluency.
Split cells 1:6 to a 1:3 (Matrigel : DMEM/F12) Matrigel-coated 6-well plate once they reach ∼80% confluency.
Remove Stem MACS and wash once with 20°C PBS.
Aspirate media from stem cells.
Apply warm dispase, incubated in 37°C water bath for 15 min, at half the normal amount of media per well (e.g., 1 mL per well of a 6-well plate).
Incubate in 37°C 5% CO2 incubator until cells begin lifting from the plate (approximately 5 minutes).
Apply an equal volume of warm DMEM:F-12 to the dispase used.
Wash cell clumps by pipetting up and down slowly with a 5 mL serological pipette 2–3 times, ensuring not to break the clumps.
Place cells in an appropriately sized conical tube and spin for 5 minutes at 162 × g, 20°C.
Resuspend cells in Stem MACS by slowly adding media and gently pipetting up and down with a 10 mL pipette until the pellet is uniformly suspended.
Slowly break up colonies using a p1000 three to five times for uniform suspension of small clumps.
Re-plate at a 1:15 ratio, including 10 μM Y27632.
Feed daily (2 mL/well) until cells reach approximately 60% confluency.
Exchange media completely when cells reach approximately 60% confluency using RPMI supplemented with 5 ng/mL BMP4, 50 ng/mL VEGF, and 1 μM CHiR (Day 2).
Wash once with RPMI without small molecules to remove dead cells before full media exchange on Day 3.
Exchange media completely to RPMI + 5 ng/mL BMP4, 50 ng/mL VEGF, and 20 ng/mL bFGF (Day 3).
Exchange media daily from Days 4 through 5 with SP34 supplemented with 15 ng/mL VEGF and 5 ng/mL bFGF.
Wash once with RPMI without small molecules to remove dead cells before full media exchange on Day 6.
Increase the volume of media to 4 mL/well starting day 6, then exchange media completely with SFD containing 50 ng/mL VEGF, 100 ng/mL bFGF, 50 ng/mL SCF, and 25 ng/mL Flt3L (Day 6).
Exchange media daily from Days 7 through 9 with fresh SFD supplemented with all components, adding 2 mL/well each day.
Collect supernatant by pulling all the media from the wells and placing into a 50 mL tube.
Centrifuge at 162 × g for 5 min at 20°C.
Aspirate the supernatant, leaving roughly 500 μL to avoid aspirating the CMPs.
Resuspend in 2 mL of SFD with small molecules.
Feed the wells with fresh media while spinning.
Add back the resuspended used media equally across the wells.
Supplement RPMI, SP34, and SFD base media daily with 2 mM glutamine, 50 μg/mL ascorbic acid, and 400 μM monothioglycerol (MTG).
Thaw and plate iAstrocytes on uncoated 6-well plates in ScienCell media (1 million cells/well).
Feed and expand iAstrocytes in ScienCell media up to day 14 of the differentiation.
Thaw a vial of 2 × 10^6 transduced hiPSCs.
Expand the hiPSCs as previously described to 2 1:50 Matrigel-coated 10-cm dishes.
Achieve ∼60% confluency on 2 10-cm dishes at day 9 for iNeuron differentiation.
Thaw CMPs in a 37°C water bath until there is a pea-sized amount of ice left.
Slowly add thawed CMP solution to 9 mL of warmed RPMI.
Spin the mixture at 162 × g for 5 min at 20°C.
Aspirate supernatant and resuspend pellet gently with a 5 ml pipette in iMg media (3.3 × 10^5 cells/mL).
Plate the cell suspension at 1 mL/well on CellBIND 24-well plate.
Let cells rest for 48 h (days 0 and 1).
Perform a half media exchange on iMicroglia.
Add fresh cytokines IL-34, M-CSF, and TGF-β1 for each media exchange.
Begin iNeuron Differentiation by exchanging Stem MACS iPS-Brew with N2 media + small molecules.
Feed iMicroglia and perform another half media exchange on iMg.
Exchange N2 media + small molecules with fresh N2 media + small molecules supplemented with 5 μg/mL puromycin.
Re-seed the iNeurons at 7.5 × 10^4 cells/well of a Matrigel-coated Nunc 8 Well chamber slide in iN media for maintenance.
Feed iMicroglia and add Ara-c to iNeurons.
Perform a full exchange on the iMicroglia.
Exchange 50% of iNrn media with iN media supplemented with 4 μM Ara-c for a final concentration of 2 μM Ara-c on day 4 of iNeuron differentiation.
Remove Ara-c and perform a full media exchange with iN media for maintenance to remove Ara-c on day 14 of iNeuron differentiation.
Re-seed iAstrocytes onto iNeurons at 5 × 10^4 cells/well of an 8 well chamber slide (∼7.1 × 10^4 cells/cm²).
Resuspend iAstrocytes in ScienCell astrocyte media to a concentration of 5 × 10^4 cells/100 μL.
Re-seed iMicroglia at 1 × 10^5 cells/well of the 8 well chamber slide (∼1.43 × 10^5 cells/cm²) on day 16 of differentiation (day 7 of iNeuron differentiation).
Lift iMicroglia into a single cell suspension with Accutase.
Use as small a tube (preferentially 2 mL Eppendorf tubes) as possible to increase yield when lifting iMicroglia.
Resuspend iMicroglia in iMg media to achieve a concentration of 1 × 10^5 cells/100 μL.
Perform a half media exchange with iN media without doxycycline on day 21 (day 12 of iNeuron differentiation).
Perform a half media exchange with iN media without doxycycline on day 26 (day 17 of iNeuron differentiation).
End the differentiation process on day 30 (day 21 of iNeuron differentiation).
